sections.title: Strict Immediate Succession with mihelyt
sections.content: The subordinating conjunction mihelyt ('as soon as / the very instant / no sooner than') marks an uncompromisingly immediate sequence of events. It conveys a sharper sense of urgency or direct dependency than amint.

sections.title: Stylistic and Syntactic Distribution
sections.content: Mihelyt often links causal prerequisites to subsequent actions in narrative prose. Like amint, it governs subordinate clauses that set off immediate consequences in the main clause.

sections.title: Instant Succession with mihelyt
rows: Mihelyt eleredt az eső a filmben, a falu lakói némán elindultak a sárban.
As soon as rain began to fall in the film, the village residents started out silently in the mud.
A néző elveszíti a szokásos időérzékét, mihelyt Tarr Béla lassú világa magába szippantja.
The viewer loses the usual sense of time as soon as Béla Tarr's slow world absorbs them.
Mihelyt Mészáros Márta bemutatta a Napló-filmeket, a cenzorok megrettentek az őszinteségétől.
No sooner had Márta Mészáros presented the Diary films than the censors were terrified by her honesty.
A valóság súlya azonnal érezhetővé válik, mihelyt a fekete-fehér képek megjelennek a vásznon.
The weight of reality becomes immediately palpable as soon as the black-and-white images appear on screen.

items.spanish: Mihelyt felcsendül a hipnotikus tangózene a kocsmában, a szereplők sorsa megpecsételődik.
items.english: As soon as the hypnotic tango music rings out in the tavern, the fate of the characters is sealed.

items.spanish: A közönség megdöbbent, mihelyt szembesült az ötvenes évek elhallgatott valóságával.
items.english: The audience was stunned as soon as they confronted the hushed-up reality of the nineteen-fifties.

items.spanish: Mihelyt véget ért a vetítés, a nézők percekig némán ültek a moziteremben.
items.english: The instant the screening ended, the audience sat silently in the cinema hall for minutes.

sections.title: B2 Usage Notice
sections.content: Choose mihelyt when you want to emphasize that not a second was lost between the two actions: 'Mihelyt megkapta az engedélyt, elindult forgatni'.
